turns.query:
WITH customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    customer."CustomerKey" AS customer_key,
    customer."FirstName" AS first_name,
    customer."LastName" AS last_name,
    MEASURE(online_sales.order_count) AS order_count,
    MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM online_sales CROSS JOIN customer
  GROUP BY customer."CustomerKey", customer."FirstName", customer."LastName"
),
customer_aov AS (
  SELECT
    customer_key,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    order_count,
    sales_amount,
    CAST(sales_amount AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(order_count, 0) AS aov
  FROM customer_metrics
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC, customer_key) AS order_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY aov DESC, customer_key) AS aov_rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_customers
  FROM customer_aov
)
SELECT
  CAST(order_rank AS BIGINT) AS order_rank,
  CAST(aov_rank AS BIGINT) AS aov_rank,
  customer_key,
  CASE
    WHEN first_name IS NULL OR first_name = 'Not Provided'
      OR last_name IS NULL OR last_name = 'Not Provided'
    THEN CAST(customer_key AS TEXT)
    ELSE first_name || ' ' || last_name
  END AS customer_name,
  order_count,
  aov
FROM ranked
WHERE ranked.order_rank <= CAST(CEIL(ranked.total_customers * 0.1) AS BIGINT)
  AND ranked.aov_rank <= CAST(CEIL(ranked.total_customers * 0.1) AS BIGINT)
ORDER BY order_count DESC, aov DESC, customer_key;
turns.assumption: 将「前 10%」理解为按客户数比例排名最高的 10%，并用客户键在同分时决定先后。

turns.query:
WITH store_year AS (
  SELECT
    sales."StoreKey" AS store_key,
    store."StoreName" AS store_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales."DateKey") AS sales_year,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM sales
  CROSS JOIN store
  WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2008-01-01'
    AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    sales."StoreKey",
    store."StoreName",
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales."DateKey")
),
store_compare AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_year = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_year = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2009
  FROM store_year
  GROUP BY store_key, store_name
),
store_decline AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    sales_2008,
    sales_2009,
    sales_2008 - sales_2009 AS store_decrease_amount,
    (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / NULLIF(sales_2008, 0) AS store_decrease_rate
  FROM store_compare
  WHERE sales_2008 > 0
    AND sales_2009 > 0
    AND sales_2009 < sales_2008
),
category_year AS (
  SELECT
    sales."StoreKey" AS store_key,
    store."StoreName" AS store_name,
    product_category."ProductCategoryName" AS category_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales."DateKey") AS sales_year,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM product_category
  CROSS JOIN (
    product_subcategory
    CROSS JOIN (
      product
      CROSS JOIN (
        sales
        CROSS JOIN store
      )
    )
  )
  WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2008-01-01'
    AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY
    sales."StoreKey",
    store."StoreName",
    product_category."ProductCategoryName",
    DATE_TRUNC('year', sales."DateKey")
),
category_compare AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_year = DATE '2008-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cat_2008,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_year = DATE '2009-01-01' THEN sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cat_2009
  FROM category_year
  GROUP BY store_key, store_name, category_name
),
category_decline AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    category_name,
    cat_2008 - cat_2009 AS category_decrease_amount
  FROM category_compare
  WHERE cat_2008 - cat_2009 > 0
),
top_category AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    category_name,
    category_decrease_amount,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY store_key
      ORDER BY category_decrease_amount DESC
    ) AS BIGINT) AS category_rank
  FROM category_decline
),
top_stores AS (
  SELECT
    store_key,
    store_name,
    sales_2008,
    sales_2009,
    store_decrease_amount,
    store_decrease_rate,
    CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY store_decrease_rate DESC, store_decrease_amount DESC
    ) AS BIGINT) AS store_rank
  FROM store_decline
)
SELECT
  ts.store_rank AS store_rank,
  ts.store_key AS store_key,
  ts.store_name AS store_name,
  ts.sales_2008 AS store_sales_2008,
  ts.sales_2009 AS store_sales_2009,
  ts.store_decrease_amount AS store_decrease_amount,
  ts.store_decrease_rate * 100 AS store_decrease_pct,
  tc.category_name AS category_name,
  tc.category_decrease_amount AS category_decrease_amount,
  tc.category_decrease_amount / NULLIF(ts.store_decrease_amount, 0) * 100 AS category_share_pct
FROM top_stores ts
JOIN top_category tc
  ON ts.store_key = tc.store_key
 AND tc.category_rank = 1
WHERE ts.store_rank <= 3
ORDER BY ts.store_rank;
turns.assumption: 同店指 2008 与 2009 均有销售的门店；「降幅」按销售额下降率排序并同时给出减少额；品类按 product→子类→品类关联，产品维度缺失的销售计入门店总额但不归入任何品类。

WITH sales_by_day_type AS (
  SELECT
    calendar."IsWorkDay" AS day_type,
    MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount
  FROM online_sales
  CROSS JOIN calendar
  WHERE calendar."IsWorkDay" IN ('WorkDay', 'WeekEnd')

  FROM sales_by_day_type

  s.sales_amount,
  t.total_sales,

FROM sales_by_day_type s
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY s.day_type;

WITH channel_avg_price AS (
  SELECT
    channel.ChannelName AS channel_name,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS sales_amount,
    MEASURE(sales.sales_quantity) AS sales_quantity
  FROM sales
  CROSS JOIN channel
  WHERE channel.ChannelName IN ('Store', 'Online')
  GROUP BY channel.ChannelName
)
SELECT

  CAST(sales_amount AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sales_quantity, 0) AS "平均单价"
FROM channel_avg_price
ORDER BY "渠道";

WITH sales_cost AS (
  SELECT sales."ProductKey" AS sales_product_key,
         MEASURE(sales.total_cost) AS total_cost
  FROM sales
  WHERE sales."DateKey" >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND sales."DateKey" < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY sales."ProductKey"
),
inv_day AS (
  SELECT inventory."ProductKey" AS inventory_product_key,
         inventory."DateKey" AS snapshot_date,
         MEASURE(inventory.snapshot_on_hand_value) AS day_value
  FROM inventory
  WHERE inventory."DateKey" >= DATE '2009-01-01'
    AND inventory."DateKey" < DATE '2010-01-01'
  GROUP BY inventory."ProductKey", inventory."DateKey"
),
inv_avg AS (
  SELECT inventory_product_key,
         AVG(day_value) AS avg_inventory_value
  FROM inv_day
  GROUP BY inventory_product_key
),
product_dim AS (
  SELECT product."ProductKey" AS dim_product_key,
         product."ProductName" AS product_name
  FROM product
  GROUP BY product."ProductKey", product."ProductName"
)
SELECT COALESCE(pd.product_name, CAST(COALESCE(sc.sales_product_key, ia.inventory_product_key) AS TEXT)) AS "产品",
       COALESCE(sc.sales_product_key, ia.inventory_product_key) AS "产品编码",
       COALESCE(sc.total_cost, 0) AS "总成本",
       ia.avg_inventory_value AS "平均在手库存金额",
       CASE
         WHEN ia.avg_inventory_value IS NULL OR ia.avg_inventory_value = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE COALESCE(sc.total_cost, 0) / ia.avg_inventory_value
       END AS "库存周转率"
FROM sales_cost sc
FULL OUTER JOIN inv_avg ia
  ON sc.sales_product_key = ia.inventory_product_key
LEFT JOIN product_dim pd
  ON pd.dim_product_key = COALESCE(sc.sales_product_key, ia.inventory_product_key)
ORDER BY "库存周转率" DESC NULLS LAST, "产品编码";
turns.assumption: 库存周转率按约定用“2009 年全渠道总成本 ÷ 该产品 2009 年各库存快照日的手在库存金额平均值”计算，统计范围为 2009 年有销售成本或库存快照的产品。
